Bid Summary.value: The RFP seeks vendors to supply new student and staff computing devices—laptops, desktops, tablets, and monitors—to Dallas ISD. Vendors may bid on any or all device categories, and the district may award contracts to one or multiple vendors per category. The solicitation requires new equipment, adherence to OEM specifications, and deployment services including software installation.
